title: Web Platform Vulnerability Assessment
summary: Authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessment of the customer web platform and its supporting infrastructure. Covered the OWASP Top 10, authentication and session handling, access control, and common misconfigurations.
highlights: Found and fixed a SQL injection before launch
Hardened session cookies and CSP
Established a monthly re-scan cadence

title: Staking Vault Smart Contract Audit
summary: Full security audit of the ARK Staking Vault contracts prior to mainnet deployment. Reviewed access control, arithmetic, external calls, reentrancy, and economic/oracle assumptions, with a Foundry test suite reproducing each finding.
objectives: Verify access control on privileged functions
Check economic assumptions and oracle usage
highlights: Caught a critical reentrancy in withdraw()
Caught a missing access-control modifier on setRewardRate()
Delivered a full Foundry PoC suite

title: External Penetration Test
summary: Black-box external penetration test of the internet-facing perimeter and web applications, simulating an unauthenticated attacker. Focused on gaining an initial foothold and escalating access.
objectives: Achieve initial access as an external attacker
Test for authentication and authorization flaws
highlights: Reached the admin console via an authentication bypass
Chained IDOR to access other tenants' data
Response team detected activity on day 2

title: Platform Load & Resilience Test
summary: Load and stress testing of the public API to establish capacity limits and identify resource-exhaustion and availability risks under peak and abusive traffic.
highlights: Found the DB connection pool exhausts at ~500 concurrent users
Recommended autoscaling + bounded pools
Established SLOs and alerting

title: Continuous Bug Hunt
summary: Ongoing internal bug-hunting program across all production assets, complementing scheduled engagements. Team members and an internal bounty surface log issues as they are found.
objectives: Continuously surface issues between formal engagements
highlights: Surfaced an exposed API key in the mobile bundle
Found a stored XSS in support tickets

title: Network Traffic Analysis
summary: Passive and active analysis of corporate and production network traffic to identify cleartext protocols, weak TLS, unexpected egress, and segmentation gaps.
highlights: Found an internal admin panel served over plain HTTP
Identified a flat network segment reaching production
Baselined egress for anomaly detection

title: Secure Code Review — Platform Monorepo
summary: Manual and tool-assisted secure code review of the platform monorepo, focused on injection, authentication/authorization, secrets handling, and dependency risk.
objectives: Find vulnerabilities in source before release
Review secrets handling and CI security
highlights: Found weak password hashing (unsalted SHA-1)
Found a vulnerable dependency with a known CVE
Flagged an over-permissive CI token

title: Red Team — Phishing & Social Engineering
summary: Authorised red-team exercise simulating a targeted phishing and social-engineering campaign against staff, to test human and technical controls and the response process.
highlights: 6 of 40 staff submitted credentials
Phishing-resistant MFA blocked account takeover
Drove passkey rollout and refresher training

title: Rewards Token Upgradeability Audit
summary: In-progress audit of the ARKT upgradeable (UUPS) proxy token, focused on initialization, storage layout, upgrade authorization and signature handling.

title: Threat Model — Payment Flow
summary: Planned STRIDE threat-modeling workshop for the new payment and checkout flow, to identify design-level risks before build.

title: Q2 External Penetration Test
summary: Scheduled follow-up external penetration test to validate remediation from the November engagement and assess new features shipped since.
